name: Barabbas
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament

points: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas, and destroy Jesus: you see that? It keeps coming up. The chief priests and the elders. Hold on. What did they do? Persuaded. So yes, there was a crowd or a mob of people crying for the death of Christ, but they were persuaded by those leaders. That was not the natural sentiment towards Christ. Remember, they wanted to take him and make him their king when Christ was on the earth. But those leaders who hated him, they didn't want that.
